instruction_audit.scope:
Audit the existing-scalar grid experiment with original Z7 instructions.

Fresh instances carry only synthetic internal flash bytes. Native scalar reads,
raw writes, startup validation, main journal and worker instructions execute.
OS/event/flash, UI-service/widget and viewport boundaries are supplied. This
does not verify physical storage, all property consumers or camera recovery.
supplied_boundaries: UI bridge to original raw setter and widgets

qemu.scope: Assisted QEMU. Menu uses native key events; shooting view invokes compiled callbacks and native visibility update diagnostically. No persistent-flash QEMU restart.

visual_inspection: Six-row menu fits, all labels readable
Golden grid has two mirrored lines per axis
6x6 has five horizontal and vertical lines
limits: Supplied OS/flash/UI/viewport boundaries in instruction tests
Assisted QEMU with functional LCD-grid model
No physical shutdown, durability, generic-consumer or recovery validation
